slides.headline: CHATGPT CAN NOW REPLACE YOUR PERSONAL TRAINER WITH 7 FREE PROMPTS THAT COVER EVERYTHING
slides.image_prompt: Smartphone on dark gym floor, glowing white OpenAI logo fills screen, white glow against navy background, no text, documentary style, film grain.

slides.headline: 1) GET A FULL FITNESS ASSESSMENT IN ONE REPLY
slides.body: A fitness coach charges $75 just to tell you where you're starting. "Act as a certified personal trainer. Analyze my fitness level, injuries, and goals. Create a starting assessment with clear targets. Details: [paste]."

slides.headline: 2) BUILD A CUSTOM WEEKLY WORKOUT PLAN TONIGHT
slides.body: Trainers charge $100 minimum for a custom plan. "Design a structured weekly workout plan based on my fitness level and goal. Include exercises, sets, reps, rest time, and progression strategy."
slides.image_prompt: Overhead close-up of a weekly training grid on a dark desk, seven day-blocks filled with symbols and check marks but no readable text, a pen resting mid-grid, stopwatch beside it. Documentary news photo, harsh flash, 35mm, film grain. Accent: white paper lines against dark charcoal.

slides.headline: 3) GET A FAT LOSS STRATEGY BUILT AROUND YOUR LIFE
slides.body: Dietitians charge $150 a session to build this. "Create a clear fat loss strategy based on my body stats and lifestyle. Include calorie guidance, activity targets, workout frequency, and habits I can follow consistently."
slides.image_prompt: Hands pulling a chrome measuring tape taut around a bare waist, shot from behind, a colorful meal-prep bowl on dark counter below, gym floor blurred, soft directional overhead light. Documentary news photo, harsh on-camera flash, 35mm, film grain. Accent: vivid green vegetables against dark charcoal.

slides.headline: 4) BUILD A MUSCLE PROGRAM WITH PROGRESSIVE OVERLOAD
slides.body: A strength coach costs $80 a session to write this. "Design a muscle-building program tailored to my experience level. Include compound lifts, accessory exercises, progressive overload plan, and recovery guidance."
slides.image_prompt: Low-angle barbell loaded with heavy iron plates on a squat rack, chalk dust suspended mid-air in a harsh side spotlight, dark industrial gym cables blurred behind. Documentary news photo, harsh on-camera flash, 35mm, film grain. Accent: rust-orange iron plates against deep black.

slides.headline: 5) CREATE A FULL NUTRITION PLAN WITH REAL NUMBERS
slides.body: A nutritionist charges $200 for a meal plan. "Create a balanced nutrition plan aligned with my fitness goal. Define calorie range, protein intake, meal timing suggestions, and simple food examples without extreme dieting."

slides.headline: 6) BUILD THE HABIT SYSTEM THAT STOPS YOU QUITTING
slides.body: Most people quit in under 3 weeks. "Build a daily fitness habit system that improves consistency. Include workout scheduling strategy, accountability methods, and realistic discipline techniques."

slides.headline: 7) RUN A FULL AUDIT ON EVERYTHING YOU'RE DOING
slides.body: After 4 to 6 weeks, a trainer charges $75 to catch what's quietly wrong. "Review my workout plan, nutrition, and recovery habits. Refine everything into a realistic system I can follow long term."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS FOR YOUR NEXT WORKOUT
slides.body:
You'll want these the moment you decide to start. Save this post and try one tonight.

Daily AI news and real skills you can use

caption:
Swipe through all 7 before you skip any. 💪 ChatGPT can now do everything a personal trainer does, for free.

Complete fitness assessment to see exactly where you're starting, personalized weekly workout plan built around your real goal, fat loss strategy for your actual lifestyle, muscle-building blueprint with progressive overload, full nutrition plan with calorie and protein targets, habit and discipline system so you don't quit after week two, complete plan audit to find and fix what's quietly not working.

Most people pay $75 a session for advice that lives inside their trainer's head. These prompts pull the same thinking from ChatGPT, on demand, for free. AI didn't replace the gym. It replaced the expensive person standing next to you. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
